title: Notice inviting Advocates for vetting / validation in the project of AI-Assisted Translation of Judgments
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: 10/03/2025 (H. M. Pavar)

FULL TEXT:
NOTICE
Requirement for work of Vetting / Validation of Translation
Applications are invited from willing Learned Advocates practicing in the High Court of
Gujarat as well as the Courts in the District Judiciary, to carry out work of vetting/validation
of Judgments of the Honourable Supreme Court of India and the Honourable High Court
of Gujarat, into vernacular language (Gujarati) and preparation and translation of Head
Notes (in English and Gujarati both languages), as per the guidelines, as part of the on-
going country-wide project of AI-Assisted Translation of Judgments of the Honourable Supreme
Court of India.
➢ The work of vetting / validation of Judgments and preparation of Head Notes as mentioned
above shall be forwarded individually to the concerned Ld. Advocate by way of email and it is
mandatory to carry out such work digitally (using computer systems) only as per the guidelines
and to return the completed work digitally by way of email within prescribed time limit.
➢ The remuneration for such work of vetting/validation (including preparation and
translation of Head Notes) shall be paid @Rs.200/- per page of the English version (pdf) of
the original Judgment of Honourable Supreme Court of India and @Rs.200/- per page of
English version (pdf) of original Judgment of Honourable High Court of Gujarat.
➢ Head Notes shall have to be prepared in English and translated into Gujarati for the
Judgments of the Honourable High Court of Gujarat, strictly as per the guidelines and format
of the Honourable Supreme Court of India, which shall be communicated at the
required time.
➢ Remuneration entitled to the concerned Ld. Advocate/s for the aforementioned work shall
be subjected to deduction on per page basis as per the prescribed norms in case of any major
lapse, negligence, mistake is revealed, upon checking, on any page/s of the vetted / validated
Judgments or Head Notes thereof.
Therefore, all interested Advocates, who are willing to carry out such work are requested
to contact the Deputy Registrar, Translation Department, at 4th Floor, ‘B’ Wing,
Administrative Building, High Court of Gujarat, Ahmedabad in person [Telephone No.:
079-27664611 (Extension No.680)], during the office hours of this High Court.
Date: 10/03/2025 (H. M. Pavar)
Editor-cum-Secretary to
the AI-Assisted Translation Monitoring Committee,
High Court of Gujarat
